rca_of_issue.issue: ConsultingMeetings page crashed with 'clients.map is not a function'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: The /api/clients endpoint returns paginated response {items: [], total, skip, limit} but React Query was extracting res.data directly and passing to .map()
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Added response format detection - if data.items exists as array, return data.items; otherwise return data or empty array
